description:
Make a looping before/after comparison GIF from two images.

A slider sweeps across the frame and reveals the before image over the after image,
with Before and After labels. Use it to show the effect of an edit such as upscaling,
retouching or colour correction. Both images should show the same scene: the before
image is resized to the after image's size. The GIF is at most 800 px on its longer
side and loops one 3 s back-and-forth sweep. A small crisp.photos mark sits in the
bottom right corner.

url_after.description: Public https URL of the edited image, showing the same scene. JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 20 MB.

url_before.description: Public https URL of the original image. JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 20 MB.

name: animate
title: Before/after comparison GIF
